# Test image credits

These two images are only used by `selftest.py` to verify the install. They are
redistributed here under their original licences.

### t0.jpg
*Portrait of a Japanese woman*, by Baron Raimund von Stillfried.
Source: [Wikimedia Commons](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Portrait_of_a_Japanese_woman_by_Baron_von_Stillfried.jpg),
via the Rijksmuseum. **Public domain.** Resized from the original.

### t1.jpg
*An older Chinese man from Harbin*, by **Sadko**.
Source: [Wikimedia Commons](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:An_older_Chinese_man_from_Harbin.jpg).
Licensed **[CC BY-SA 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0)**.
Credit as requested by the author: "Sadko, Wikipedia". Resized from the original;
not otherwise modified.

Because t1.jpg is share-alike, any *derivative* of it — including swap results
written by `selftest.py` — carries the same licence. That is why `outputs/` is
git-ignored rather than committed.
